name: BrilliantMinds PDF Embed
author: brilliantminds

sections.description:
BrilliantMinds PDF Embed turns any PDF into a clean, modern reading experience inside your content. Visitors read the document right on your page, with no plugins to install and no third-party services involved. Everything runs from your own server.

Highlights

  • PDF Viewer block for the block editor: upload or choose a PDF, adjust options in the sidebar.
  • Shortcode for the classic editor, page builders and widgets: [bmpdf url="https://example.com/file.pdf"]
  • Continuous scroll or one page at a time, with swipe navigation on touch screens.
  • Zoom, fit to width, fit to page, rotate and a page number field.
  • Light, dark or automatic color scheme, plus a toggle so visitors can choose.
  • Fullscreen mode, download, print and open-in-new-tab buttons. Each one can be turned off.
  • Selectable, copyable text.
  • Your accent color, corner radius, shadow, width, height and alignment.
  • Top or bottom toolbar, as a full-width bar or a floating pill.
  • Load on click option so pages with several PDFs stay fast.
  • Auto-embed option: paste a PDF link on its own line and it becomes a viewer.
  • Lazy rendering: only the pages near the screen are drawn, so large documents stay smooth.
  • Accessible: keyboard shortcuts, labeled controls, visible focus and reduced-motion support.
  • Privacy friendly: no tracking, no cookies, no external requests. The theme toggle remembers a visitor’s choice in their own browser.
  • Translation ready.

Shortcode options

All options are optional and override the defaults from Settings > PDF Viewer.

  • url – link to the PDF file.
  • id – Media Library attachment ID (use instead of url).
  • title – title shown in the toolbar.
  • width, height – for example width="80%" height="600".
  • align – left, center or right.
  • mode – scroll or single.
  • zoom – width, page or a percentage such as 125.
  • page – page to open first.
  • theme – auto, light or dark.
  • accent – hex color, for example #0f766e.
  • radius – corner radius in pixels.
  • toolbar_position – top or bottom. toolbar_style – bar or floating.
  • On/off options (use 1 or 0): shadow, show_title, page_input, zoom_controls, rotate, theme_toggle, fullscreen, download, print, open_new, text_select, disable_context, load_on_click.

Example: [bmpdf id="123" height="600" theme="dark" mode="single" download="0"]

Developers

Use the bmpdf_viewer_config filter to change the configuration passed to the viewer.

Third-party libraries

This plugin bundles PDF.js by Mozilla, version 4.10.38, licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (compatible with GPLv2 or later).

  • Source code and project page: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
  • Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist (version 4.10.38, legacy/build files)
  • Files in assets/vendor/pdfjs/: pdf.min.js and pdf.worker.min.js are the unmodified legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs and pdf.worker.min.mjs files from that package, renamed to .js (so that every web server sends the correct content type) and with the trailing source-map comment removed. cmaps/ and standard_fonts/ are copied unchanged from the same package. The license is in assets/vendor/pdfjs/LICENSE.txt.
  • To rebuild the minified files from source, follow the build instructions in the PDF.js repository at the tag v4.10.38.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the brilliantminds-pdf-embed folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings > PDF Viewer to choose your defaults.
  4. Edit a post or page, add the PDF Viewer block, and choose a PDF. Or use the shortcode.
sections.faq:
Does it work with PDFs hosted on another website?

Only if that website allows cross-origin requests (CORS). If it does not, the viewer shows a button that opens the file directly. PDFs in your own Media Library always work.

Can I stop people from downloading the PDF?

You can hide the download and print buttons and disable right-click. This keeps casual visitors from saving the file, but a PDF that is publicly viewable can always be saved by a determined visitor. For truly private documents, use a membership or access-control plugin.

Are password-protected PDFs supported?

Yes. The viewer asks the visitor for the password.

Does it send data to any external service?

No. The viewer library is bundled with the plugin and all files are loaded from your own site.

Why is my PDF shown as a link instead of a viewer?

The link is shown while the viewer loads, or when JavaScript is disabled, or when the file cannot be read (for example because of missing CORS headers).

Does it work with page builders?

Yes, any builder with a shortcode or shortcode widget element works. If you add a viewer dynamically after the page loads, call window.BMPDF.init().

short_description: Embed PDF files with a fast, beautiful, responsive viewer. Includes a block, shortcode, dark mode, zoom, fullscreen and many options.
